dc0a5955cb7080e5bee0dc20e3130b9f.overview: In rural Western Massachusetts, 11-year-old Lacy spends the summer of 1991 at home, enthralled by her own imagination and the attention of her mother, Janet. As the months pass, three visitors enter their orbit, all captivated by Janet.

dc2a9d69b1fd68b7ff6c6dd6fc6ea7f5.overview: An Episcopal Bishop, Henry Brougham, has been working for months on the plans for an elaborate new cathedral which he hopes will be paid for primarily by a wealthy, stubborn widow. He is losing sight of his family and of why he became a churchman in the first place. Enter Dudley, an angel sent to help him. Dudley does help everyone he meets, but not necessarily in the way they would have preferred. With the exception of Henry, everyone loves him, but Henry begins to believe that Dudley is there to replace him, both at work and in his family's affections, as Christmas approaches.
dc2a9d69b1fd68b7ff6c6dd6fc6ea7f5.tagline: Have you heard about Cary and the bishop's wife?

dc426841a4ceba1d14bcc85d50b9dade.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.

dc44533fbc0b8d5d5b14e8ebe3ed97a7.overview: Summer heats up in rural Louisiana beside Eve’s Bayou, 1962, as the Batiste family tries to survive the secrets they’ve kept and the betrayals they’ve endured.
dc44533fbc0b8d5d5b14e8ebe3ed97a7.tagline: The secrets that hold us together can also tear us apart.

dc4d8acac7c2080d7be06d77bd6a5b94.overview: A chronicle of the lives of the Gibbons family, from shortly after the end of the First World War to the beginning of the Second.

dc52cf44c976c149c083bf4f59146a7c.overview: A down-and-out gangster hires a down-on-his-luck agent to make his girlfriend a recording star within six weeks.

dc5e5add221813690905c706e5a107c8.overview: In the early days of World War II, a German U-boat is sunk in Canada's Hudson Bay. Hoping to evade capture, a small band of German soldiers led by commanding officer Lieutenant Hirth attempts to cross the border into the United States, which has not yet entered the war and is officially neutral. Along the way, the German soldiers encounter brave men such as a French-Canadian fur trapper, Johnnie, a leader of a Hutterite farming community, Peter, an author, Philip and a soldier, Andy Brock.
dc5e5add221813690905c706e5a107c8.tagline: THE MIGHTEST MANHUNT THAT EVER SWEPT THE SCREEN!

dc8d8ccfd5369101d0d2f700fcfca556.overview: Humanity finds a mysterious object buried beneath the lunar surface and sets off to find its origins with the help of HAL 9000, the world's most advanced super computer.
dc8d8ccfd5369101d0d2f700fcfca556.tagline: An epic drama of adventure and exploration.

dca1bb812beafb9c37ed5180758afb76.overview: Twenty years after their notorious tabloid romance gripped the nation, a married couple buckles under the pressure when an actress arrives to do research for a film about their past.

dca951910c497d4d1f1ee8dd23808c05.overview: Successful and married with children, paper-mill owner Jihei knows better than to contradict the strict social and moral codes of 18th-century Japan. But when he meets the lovely courtesan Koharu, he becomes a man obsessed. Koharu returns his love, even foregoing other customers while Jihei schemes to somehow buy her freedom. His efforts yield ruinous consequences for his business and his family life, and Koharu is meanwhile purchased by another client.

dcbdc0a20c15c0a92b0813e1e8f29ab2.overview: Brian Cohen is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother, the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs.
dcbdc0a20c15c0a92b0813e1e8f29ab2.tagline: He's not the messiah...he's just a naughty boy.

dcbde8c1ad8c7871168181a4c528b4db.overview: Brothel owner, Margaret Wells, struggles to raise her daughters in London during the 18th century.

dcbf9d5b7b1f0df9c0921f2bea21fc42.overview: Prominent gang leader Cyrus calls a meeting of New York's gangs to set aside their turf wars and take over the city. At the meeting, a rival leader kills Cyrus, but a Coney Island gang called the Warriors is wrongly blamed for Cyrus' death. Before you know it, the cops and every gangbanger in town is hot on the Warriors' trail.
dcbf9d5b7b1f0df9c0921f2bea21fc42.tagline: These are the armies of the night. They are 100,000 strong. They outnumber the cops five to one. They could run New York City. Tonight they're all out to get the Warriors.

dcf0e1962765bbf97c731f1aefa2a986.overview: A Swedish immigrant family struggles to adapt to their new life on the American frontier during the second half of the 19th century amidst civil war, native uprising and the lure of gold in California.
dcf0e1962765bbf97c731f1aefa2a986.tagline: From "The Emigrants" dream, come the settlers struggle to survive...
